item.title: Mas+ 0.1.0
item.description:
• feat: auto-updates with Sparkle and tag-based release workflow
  • feat: screen recording from the notch, clipboard and screenshot improvements
  • docs: update plan with done features, backlog and screen recording notes
  • feat: clipboard history with screenshots grid, copy toast, mirror tab and tabs beside the notch
  • feat: tab navigation inside the expanded notch
  • feat: notch base window with hover expand and glass background
